title: AgroTech+ Clean Version
summary: A Next.js/Prisma agricultural platform with role-based dashboards for customers, farmers, operations, drivers, and admins, built as a dependency-free version of a larger app for local development. Its ml/requirements.txt lists sdv and ctgan as commented-out dependencies that are never imported or called in the codebase.
evidence: ml/requirements.txt: '# sdv==1.10.0' and '# ctgan==0.7.3' (commented out, no matching code hits)
needs: Lines are commented out in requirements.txt and no ML code references them; likely leftover/unused dependency.
